No network or analytics. All analysis is on-device. Incoming-SMS protection is optional and opt-in.

No network requests. All analysis runs entirely on the device.
SMS protection is optional and off by default. When enabled, incoming SMS is analyzed on-device only and never stored or uploaded.
No analytics and no message-content logging.
User-entered and received text stays on the device. Nothing is uploaded to a server.
Extracted links are never opened or executed automatically.
The original message is always preserved; nothing is silently modified.
RECEIVE_SMS and POST_NOTIFICATIONS are optional and only used for the opt-in SMS protection feature. The app requests no INTERNET or storage access, and all analysis runs locally.
Analyze new text messages fully on-device. OTP, transaction and login messages are skipped. Safe messages stay silent.
